# @arki/offline

> Offline-first toolkit for ARKI apps: persisted query cache, a mutation queue with replay, local collections, PWA helpers, status hooks and a dev panel.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/offline/query`: `PersistedQueryClientProvider`, `QueryCachePersistFailed`, `createIdbPersister`, `createPersistedQueryClient`, `useIsRestoring`; types `CreateIdbPersisterOptions`, `CreatePersistedQueryClientOptions`, `IdbPersister`, `PersistedQueryClient`, `PersistedQueryClientProviderProps`.
- `@arki/offline/mutations`: @arki/offline/mutations. `DRAIN_FAILURES`, `ENQUEUE_FAILURES`, `OFFLINE_QUEUE_FAILURES`, `OfflineQueueProvider`, `QUEUE_STORAGE_FAILURES`, `QueueAcceptanceUnconfirmed`, `QueueEffectUnconfirmed`, `QueueEncodingFailure`, `QueuePersistenceUnconfirmed`, `QueueStorageCorrupt`, `QueueStorageUnavailable`, `QueueTransportUnavailable`; and 32 more.

- `@arki/offline/pwa`: `createStrategy`, `registerOfflineRoutes`; types `ApiRouteConfig`, `AppShellConfig`, `FetchStrategy`, `RegisterOfflineRoutesOptions`, `StaticAssetConfig`, `StrategyConfig`.
- `@arki/offline/status`: `OfflineBanner`, `useOnlineStatus`, `useQueueDepth`; types `OfflineBannerProps`, `OfflineBannerState`, `OnlineStatus`.
- `@arki/offline/orpc`: `IDEMPOTENCY_STORE_FAILURES`, `IdempotencyRepository`, `IdempotencyStoreUnconfirmed`, `SqliteIdempotencyRepository`, `createIdempotencyTable`, `idempotency`, `idempotencyKeyId`, `idempotencyKeys`, `offlineSafe`; types `IdempotencyDatabase`, `IdempotencyKeyId`, `IdempotencyKeysTable`; and 6 more.

<!-- llms:end -->

## Start here
- [README](README.md): the three tiers, collections, status, troubleshooting.

## By task
- Keep reads across reloads (Tier 1): `createIdbPersister`, `PersistedQueryClientProvider` from `@arki/offline/query`.
- Queue writes while offline (Tier 2): `@arki/offline/mutations` and the idempotency marker in `@arki/offline/orpc`.
- Cache the app shell: `registerOfflineRoutes` from `@arki/offline/pwa`.
- Wire it all: `createOfflineRuntime()` from `@arki/offline/preset`.
- Local data: `@arki/offline/collections`. Online state: `@arki/offline/status`. Debug panel: `@arki/offline/devtools`.

## Rules that bite
- A replayed write can run twice. Handlers must be idempotent; see the README on idempotency keys.
- Tier 3 (true local-first sync) is deferred.
- The dev panel is dev-only and costs nothing in production.
